cases.question_summary: Select or force CSP layout in a transpilation pipeline.
cases.category_rationale: The question asks which layout pass is selected and why csp_layout is rejected as a layout selector.

cases.question_summary: Resolve an Aer import failure in a Colab Qiskit installation.
cases.category_rationale: The requested change concerns where the Aer public API is imported.

cases.question_summary: Use consistent physical-qubit layouts for calibration and a real-device experiment.
cases.category_rationale: The question centers on readout-error mitigation and mapping calibration circuits to physical qubits.

cases.question_summary: Create missing Qiskit and IPython user configuration files.
cases.category_rationale: This is environment configuration, the closest supplied category; the question contains no quantum computation.

cases.question_summary: Trace out a whole quantum register rather than naming individual qubit indices.
cases.category_rationale: Selecting subsystems for a partial trace determines the reduced quantum state.

cases.question_summary: Compute expressibility and entanglement capability of parameterized circuits.
cases.category_rationale: The requested outputs are numerical circuit-quality measures; statevector array handling is a secondary implementation issue.

cases.question_summary: Apply depolarizing error to two-qubit operations.
cases.category_rationale: The central issue is matching a noise channel to the arity of the affected gate.

cases.question_summary: Retrieve unitary, statevector and density-matrix outputs from AerSimulator.
cases.category_rationale: The question concerns extracting simulator result data.

cases.question_summary: Work around an unsupported set_frequency instruction in PulseSimulator.
cases.category_rationale: The question concerns simulator support and pulse-frequency execution.

cases.question_summary: Append an instruction with variable-length quantum registers as its arguments.
cases.category_rationale: The question asks how to supply one ordered qubit argument per instruction wire.

cases.question_summary: Compose a wider subroutine by mapping data qubits and allocating its extra ancillas.
cases.category_rationale: Circuit composition, register allocation and ancilla mapping are the stated task.

cases.question_summary: Obtain the unitary matrix for a quantum circuit.
cases.category_rationale: The requested deliverable is a circuit matrix extracted from execution.

cases.question_summary: Run a two-qubit Bell experiment despite a one-qubit backend capacity error.
cases.category_rationale: The reported failure is insufficient backend/coupling-map capacity.

cases.question_summary: Condition quantum operations on multiple classical measurement results.
cases.category_rationale: The question asks how to express a classical condition in circuit construction.

cases.question_summary: Compute a noisy expectation value for a general non-Pauli observable.
cases.category_rationale: Noisy simulation of an observable is primary; converting it to a supported operator form is secondary.

cases.question_summary: Understand when measurements are needed to obtain qasm-simulator counts.
cases.category_rationale: The question is about the relationship between measurement operations and reported outcomes.

cases.question_summary: Identify a standard gate from its unitary matrix.
cases.category_rationale: The core task is matching mathematical operators to standard gate names.

cases.question_summary: Explain which of multiple Qiskit job-monitor interfaces to use.
cases.category_rationale: The original question concerns monitoring execution; it is not primarily a request to migrate a removed API.

cases.question_summary: Load and simulate an OpenQASM 2 program in Python with Qiskit.
cases.category_rationale: Parsing QASM into the intended executable circuit is the central task.

cases.question_summary: Extract raw 0/1 outcomes from a Hadamard coin-flip experiment for a GUI.
cases.category_rationale: The question asks for usable result data instead of a Result-object representation.

cases.question_summary: Build a tight-binding Hamiltonian from tensor products of Pauli operators and use it as a gate.
cases.category_rationale: The question concerns the mathematical construction and meaning of the operator and its evolution.

cases.question_summary: Transpile a circuit to the H, T and CNOT universal gate set.
cases.category_rationale: The question asks for compilation into a restricted universal basis.

cases.question_summary: Construct a Z string acting on a specified interval of qubits within an N-qubit system.
cases.category_rationale: The mathematical support and embedding of the operator are the requested behavior.

cases.question_summary: Express U1 using Rx, Ry and Rz while preserving its phase, or establish why that is impossible.
cases.category_rationale: The question explicitly distinguishes exact matrix equality from equality up to global phase.
